title: Celebrating 32 Blessed & Battle-Tested Years with My Beloved Pinky 🌹
paragraphs: Celebrating 32 Blessed & Battle-Tested Years with My Beloved Pinky 🌹

Thirty-two years ago, God did something quietly miraculous—He entrusted my life, my calling, my weaknesses, and my future to the hands of one woman. And every single day since then, Pinky, you have proven that His choice was perfect.

Our love story was never just about romance. It was about covenant. About choosing each other not only in seasons of laughter, but in moments of tears, uncertainty, sacrifice, and faith. We did not survive 32 years by accident—we endured because God was at the center of our marriage.

“Though one may be overpowered, two can defend themselves. A cord of three strands is not quickly broken.”
—Ecclesiastes 4:12

You have been my partner in prayer, my safe place in storms, my joy in victories, and my strength when mine was gone. Your love taught me patience. Your faith taught me endurance. Your presence taught me what it truly means to be blessed.
There were days when we had little—yet we lacked nothing, because love was abundant. There were seasons when the road was hard—but God was faithful, and you never left my side.

“Love is patient, love is kind… It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.”
—1 Corinthians 13:4,7

Pinky, your smile has carried me through weary days. Your quiet faith has preached louder than many sermons. Your loyalty has been my daily reminder that true love still exists in a world that often forgets its meaning.
Today, we don’t just celebrate years—we celebrate grace. We celebrate forgiveness that healed us, prayers that sustained us, and a God who never failed us.

“The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make His face shine upon you.”
—Numbers 6:24–26

To our family and friends who walked with us through this journey—thank you for witnessing our story. If our marriage has ever reminded you that love is worth fighting for, then all the struggles were worth it.
My beloved Pinky—my wife, my companion, my answered prayer—after 32 years, my heart still chooses you. And I will choose you again tomorrow, and every day God grants us.
Here’s to more years of faith, laughter, purpose, and love—until the very end.
